absoluteLevel.ground: The easy requirement is broad adult factual accessibility with four plausible alternatives. Here lexical extraction and context mismatch permit selection without knowledge. That is not evidence that a clean version of the park-identity fact is broadly known. Preserve easy and redesign; no mechanical reclassification or source PASS adopted.

taxonomyAndAntiOverlap.ground: A protected park uniting two specific landforms is park geography. Landmarks asks the identity of a monolith from sacred Anangu association; geology peers ask rock material, formation or classification. The current MAIN pair relation is distinct despite common Uluru entity. Editorial defects are separately recorded.
